TokenMeter v0.2.4 adds the latest Anthropic and OpenAI model price mappings.

- Add Claude Opus 5.5 standard pricing, including its $0.20 per million cache reads and separate 5m/1h cache writes.
- Add GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna to both the general and Codex catalogs, including long-context pricing and Codex API Fast/Priority multipliers.
- Preserve all existing model rates, fallback choices, and dated historical prices. Newly recognized model IDs use their own prices instead of previous fallback estimates when local caches rebuild.

Prices were verified on September 23, 2026 against [Anthropic pricing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing) and [OpenAI pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing). These are API-equivalent estimates, not subscription charges.

Quota refresh and usage-only behavior for accounts without subscription login are unchanged. Requires macOS 13 or later; the universal archive supports Apple Silicon and Intel.
